creative_improvements.idea: MFE proof-of-life filter for STANDALONE_BYPASS entries — require net 1m price movement in trade direction >= 0.05% over last 3 candles before standalone bypass can open a trade
creative_improvements.rationale: hard_max_loss is #1 loss family (14d ≈ -$6.22 across top signals, all 0% WR). Watchdog confirms MFE~0.125% on losers = price never moved in trade direction before stop. Winners in same signals trail via profit-monster (bb-squeeze+ 46T 82.6% +$2.63/7d). A pre-entry directional movement check catches 'entries that never worked' at detection time without blocking momentum already in motion. STANDALONE_BYPASS is the common path for all these bleeding signals.
creative_improvements.expected_impact: Reduce hard_max_loss bleed without touching exit configs (P2 verdict: configs near-optimal). Estimated: block 30-50% of hard_max_loss entries if pre-entry momentum is as weak as MFE suggests. Needs backtest against 7d profit-monster winners before any implementation.
creative_improvements.implementation_note: Post-freeze only. Backtest first: pull1m candles before each 14d hard_max_loss entry vs profit-monster winner entries, measure net 3-bar movement distribution. If losers cluster at <0.05% and winners at >=0.05%, filter is viable. Constants in hermes_constants.py, not hardcoded.
